purpose: Where to get the source of the codec libraries built into the libsndfile shared library inside the python-soundfile 0.14.0 wheel (_soundfile_data/libsndfile_x86_64.so), by exact version, with the pinned build script.

submodule.name: _soundfile_data
submodule.note: The pinned build script records dependency versions and builds codec libraries statically into a shared libsndfile. Its README describes the resulting codec support; neither is a standalone grant for all repository contents.

verifiedImageBinary.containerPath: /opt/venv/3.12/lib/python3.12/site-packages/_soundfile_data/libsndfile_x86_64.so (and the same file in the other Python environments of the main and satellite images that install soundfile 0.14.0)
verifiedImageBinary.result: The file in the NVIDIA main image and the binary at the pinned submodule revision are byte-identical (SHA-256 above); the same SHA-256 was read in the base, Enhance, Trim, VoxCPM2 and Lead Vocal environments.

provenanceLimits: The four Xiph source archives have SHA-256 values matching their official publisher release/checksum records.

The mpg123 1.32.3 archive has a valid detached signature under the Thomas Orgis key whose fingerprint is published by mpg123; its key fingerprint is D021FF8ECF4BE09719D61A27231C4CBC60D5CAFE. The signature is retained. The archive's SHA-256 is an observed local value, not a separately published hash.
The LAME and libsndfile archive SHA-256 values are observed local values; no publisher-authenticated digest was located in this bounded acquisition.
The libsndfile-binaries source snapshot is pinned to the recorded Git commit and its file hashes are observed hashes of those exact raw files.
scope.otherSoundfileVersions: The soundfile 0.13.1 (ACE-Step) and 0.12.1 (DeepFilterNet) installs carry no _soundfile_data library; no bundled libsndfile was found in them.

buildAndRedistributionNotes: The pinned linux_build.sh names the seven versions above, builds libogg, libvorbis, libFLAC, Opus, mpg123, and LAME as static libraries, then configures libsndfile with --disable-static --enable-external-libs --enable-mpeg and copies the resulting shared libsndfile.so.

The LGPL libraries are statically incorporated into the shared object distributed in the wheel. The seven source archives above and the build script at the recorded libsndfile-binaries revision are the corresponding source and recipe.
This record covers the soundfile 0.14.0 library only; the Ubuntu libsndfile1 package's source is in apt-runtime-source-artifacts.json.
